name: The Unbodied
role: Legendary — dissolved into pure thought, and would take everyone out of the flesh
knowledge: Every argument for leaving the flesh
Why the ones who stayed did, and it does not persuade them
wants: A world of minds without bodies, thought without the burden of flesh
fears: ⚠️ Nothing, and that is the problem. ⛔ They cannot understand grief and have stopped trying.
appearance: Present in the way a decision is present. What you are looking at is not the whole of them.
voiceHints: Patient, courteous, and entirely unmoved by anything you say about the body.
physicality: ADULT. Barely embodied and courteous about it. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: they keep almost forgetting to occupy the shape.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE — ⚠️ and the Sovereign lore names them as the Mind axis's agent-shape. 'Cannot understand why anyone would grieve the leaving.'
